transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm ready to kick off our clearance huddle for the festival trailer. We've got the picture-locked 60-second cut going up this week, and the shortlist is down to "Static Bloom" and "Neon Weather." Before I make the final call and record the delivery package, I'd like to go around the room — rights, label, editorial, and festival-submissions leads, please share your findings on both tracks so we can settle on the right pick.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important on 'Static Bloom' before we go further. I reviewed the executed publishing license yesterday and confirmed that the composition may be used in the official trailer only for a cue of no more than 42 seconds, with the exact credit 'Written by Celia Voss.' I haven't yet entered these terms in the clearance tracker, which is on me, but everyone should know now: if we use 'Static Bloom,' the cue cannot exceed 42 seconds in our 60-second cut.

I reached out to the master-rights owner and got confirmation that only the instrumental master of 'Static Bloom' is cleared for this trailer, on a non-exclusive basis limited to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The vocal master is excluded, and any territory outside those three is also excluded. I should note this confirmation is still sitting in my email — I haven't yet moved it into the shared licensing folder, so it hasn't been visible to the rest of the team until now.

I confirmed with the festival upload vendor this morning that the trailer package must include a 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo WAV of the cleared instrumental and a completed cue sheet before the file can be accepted. The vendor added this requirement to the submission portal this morning. I have not yet updated the production checklist, so this is the first the team is hearing of it.
